name: Leaderboard bars race with avatar chips
looks: Three bars grow up from a baseline, each topped with a round avatar-initial chip, a rank numeral badge, a name and a running count. The centre bar (first place) is tallest and in the accent colour; the two side bars are shorter and neutral. A second version of the same layout cuts in a beat later with the counts incremented, as if the leaderboard is live.
build: Bars scaleY from 0 to final height from a bottom origin on an uneven stagger (centre bar leads). Avatar chips and rank badges pop in with a small overshoot (spring, response ~0.3) once their bar lands. The incremented second card is a hard cut, not a tween, to read as a fresh data pull rather than continuous motion.
sound: A rising blip per bar as it grows, a brighter chime on the first-place bar landing, a soft tick on the hard cut to the updated numbers.
prompt: Grow three ranked bars up from a baseline, the leader tallest and in the accent colour, each one topped with a small avatar chip, a rank number and a running count. Cut to the same layout a beat later with the counts ticked up, so the board reads as live rather than a one-off chart.
